document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The limestone is soft here. With a knife, you can dig handholds 
and climb up. Make a STR roll: if successful, go to 441; if you 
fail, you are falling—attempt a Luck roll. If you fail the Luck roll, 
your fall breaks your knife, go to 406—you cannot get out this 
way (unless you have another knife) and must continue to 420. If 
you do have another knife, you can try again, otherwise go to 406.
(406)
